about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm a Multimedia Engineer passionate about programming in all its areas, especially when it blends creativity with building rich, memorable user experiences. While my specialisation is frontend development, my background and constant learning also let me work comfortably on backend, mobile apps, video games and virtual reality.
During my degree I spent a full academic year on Erasmus in the Czech Republic, an experience that gave me a great deal of autonomy and the ability to adapt to completely new environments.

At heart, I enjoy defining the logic that brings interfaces to life and looking for solutions that combine functionality, creativity and a good user experience. In my free time I make video games in Unity and experiment with personal programming projects.
about.lead: Multimedia Engineer specialised in frontend development, with experience in backend, mobile apps, video games and virtual reality.
